title: Chess Game of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought everything was under his control, an ancient jade slip from decades past quietly glowed. The characters on it made his pupils constrict—it was the only clue Chen Nian left before disappearing.

text.content: Above the high platform, the will of the Heavenly Eye pressed down like tangible substance, causing the void to tremble. "Three months." The cold voice echoed in everyone's ears. "Find the complete version of the Tianji Record and offer it to me, otherwise—annihilation." Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest. That will had already planted a countdown restriction in his soul. Three months of life, like a sword hanging above his head. Representatives of various forces around held their breath, waiting to see his choice.

Three months? Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding the cold gleam that flickered in his gaze. Heavenly Eye, you think this can trap me? He coldly smiled to himself. The Heavenly Fate remained at ninety-five points, each foresight costing five points—this meant he still had nineteen opportunities to glimpse the future. Nineteen times was enough to tear open a bloody path in despair. He slowly raised his head, the fear on his face perfectly measured: "...Disciiple accepts the mission."

dialogue.content: "Very well." No emotion could be detected in the Heavenly Eye's voice. "Remember, you have only one chance." The will in the void slowly dissipated, leaving only an asphyxiating silence. Chen Ji noticed that in the moment before its disappearance, its gaze seemed to linger on Su Qingyao for an instant.

text.content: Silence spread like a tide. Representatives of various forces looked at each other, none daring to speak first. Was a person under direct death sentence from the Heavenly Dao worth betting on? Chen Ji swept his gaze across the entire venue, taking in the hesitation, calculation, and watchfulness on every face. Good, he silently thought, let you all see whose game this really is.

choice.prompt: Facing this deadly ground, Chen Ji needed to first stabilize the situation—how should he present himself?

choices.description: Advance by retreating, display the "trash" persona, make everyone lower their guard
choices.risk_hint: Risk being treated as an easy target

text.content: Chen Ji clasped his hands and bowed to all sides, his voice carrying a hoarse quality: "Elders, forgive my laughter—finding the Tianji Record in three months... this disciple can only do his best and leave the rest to fate." He slightly bowed, his posture extremely low, looking exactly like a pitiful wretch driven to a dead end. Several cultivators who had been eager to step on him to advance now showed contempt in their eyes.

choices.description: Reveal the true bearing beneath the "trash" exterior to intimidate lesser men
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from higher authorities

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile so composed it was unlike a man facing death. "Three months?" he softly repeated, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness. "Enough." These simple two words made everyone present's heart tighten. This trash... when did he develop such bearing?

choices.text: Leverage the momentum to shift focus
choices.description: Direct the conflict toward the Heavenly Eye, benefiting from the situation

text.content: "The Heavenly Will is lofty and supreme, yet demands a servant disciple to search for the complete Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's tone shifted, carrying a hint of self-mockery. "Elders, you are all pillars of the sect—surely more qualified than this disciple for such an important task." Upon hearing this, the representatives' expressions became complicated—this statement was like passing a hot potato into their arms.

As the crowd's thoughts diverged, a cold voice broke the silence. "The Tianji Record belongs to the Tianqing Sect." Su Qingyao stepped forward, her aura as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow fully displayed. "Since Chen Ji is a disciple of Tianqing Sect, it is only natural that he bears responsibility for retrieving the sect's treasure." Her gaze swept across everyone like a sword. "Anyone who stabs him in the back now makes an enemy of the Tianqing Sect."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao glanced at Chen Ji and lowered her voice so only he could hear: "Stop pretending. I know what you're scheming." Her lips curved slightly, a half-smile playing at her expression. "But this time, I'll help you." Chen Ji felt a jolt in his heart—how much did she know? Before he could respond, Su Qingyao had already turned to the crowd, her voice clear and resonant: "In the name of Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, I declare—the Tianqing Sect fully supports Chen Ji in recovering the Tianji Record!"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's declaration broke the deadlock. How should Chen Ji respond to this support?

choices.description: Accept her support but maintain distance, not letting her get too deeply involved
choices.visible_reward: Protect Su Qingyao from being implicated

text.content: "Thank you, Senior Sister Su." Chen Ji clasped his hands in salute, his tone sincere yet appropriate. He didn't say more, but in that moment of eye contact, Su Qingyao read the apology in his eyes—he was protecting her. "This guy..." she sighed internally, "He really is still that fool who carries everything on his own shoulders."

choices.description: Proactively discuss with her, showing willingness to face things together
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally, with improved coordination between the two
choices.risk_hint: She might sense more of the truth

text.content: "Since Senior Sister has seen through me, I won't hide anymore." Chen Ji's voice was audible only to her. "Three months is too long. I only need thirty days." Su Qingyao's pupils contracted slightly—thistrash... actually dared to compress the Heavenly Eye's deadline by another third? "What exactly are you planning to do?" "To do something... that should have been completed thirty years ago." He smiled faintly, then turned to face the crowd. "Since the Tianqing Sect has made its position clear, does anyone else have concerns?"

choices.description: Appear to accept support on the surface, but actually use her resources as your own bargaining chips
choices.visible_reward: Maximize utilization of her resource network
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, the relationship might be broken

text.content: Su Qingyao raised an eyebrow. She noticed a fleeting glint of calculation in Chen Ji's eyes—a scheming light. This person... indeed not as simple as she thought. But she didn't expose him, only nodding slightly, going along with his rhythm. "Interesting," she thought internally. "More and more interesting."

Su Qingyao's declaration was like a stone casting ripples across still water. "The Tianqing Sect fully supports?" A representative from a medium-sized sect said sarcastically, "Senior Sister Su, is your Tianqing Sect betting against Heavenly Will? Atrash servant disciple who can't find the Tianji Record in three months—will you all accompany him to destruction?" Before the words even faded, another voice coldly rang out: "I think the Tianqing Sect dares to lead the way, which is admirable." It was an elder from the Xuanwu Sect. He looked at Chen Ji with a complex gaze, clearly lost in thought.

dialogue.content: "Elders and seniors, this junior has something to say." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice not loud yet silencing everyone. He slowly surveyed the crowd, a faint smile playing at his lips: "What Heavenly Will wants is the complete Tianji Record, not this junior's life. If I die, the Tianji Record becomes even harder to find—do you think Heavenly Will would do something so foolish?" At these words, everyone's expressions shifted. He continued: "In other words, what you're betting on when you support this junior isn't whether I survive, but whether I can find the Tianji Record. If I find it, you'll have meritorious service; if I don't..." He shrugged, "This junior is just atrash, death is nothing to mourn. What would you lose?"

text.content: This speech left all the representatives speechless. They exchanged glances, rapidly calculating in their minds—thetrash is right! Heavenly Will wants results, not the process. As long as he's still searching, they have a retreat path; if he actually finds it... "I, Yuling Valley, am willing to lend Chen Daoist friend a helping hand!" The first to eat the crab appeared—it was an elder from Yuling Valley, beaming as he stepped forward. "Though my Yuling Valley is small, we have considerable expertise in intelligence networks. Perhaps we can be of assistance to Chen Daoist friend."

With someone taking the lead, the situation instantly reversed. "I, Qingyun Pavilion, am willing to provide spirit stone funding!" "I, Xuanming Sect, am willing to send disciples for escort duty!" Voices rose one after another. The representatives of various powers seemed to have forgotten they were merely observing moments ago,，纷纷表态支持. Chen Ji stood in place, his face showing appropriately timed gratitude, but his eyes were ice-cold—these随风倒的家伙, truly unreliable. But it was fine. He sneered internally, today's situation would serve his purpose well.

choice.prompt: All factions are defecting, and Chen Ji must decide how to allocate these "supports"

choices.description: Accept all who come, use their resources to expand influence, secretly screen for useful people
choices.visible_cost: Need to divide attention to deal with factions with ulterior motives
choices.visible_reward: Intelligence network, spirit stones, and personnel increase significantly
choices.risk_hint: Some enemy spies may be mixed among them

text.content: "Your kindness, I, Chen Ji, will forever remember in my heart." Chen Ji cupped his hands in thanks, his posture humble. In the crowd, he noticed several unfamiliar faces quietly observing him, their gazes flickering. These people... which side sent them? He made a mental note to have Mo Xiansheng investigate later. "Since you are all willing to help, I, Chen, shall not be impolite." He smiled faintly, a sharp glint flashing in his eyes.

choices.description: Only accept truly valuable factions, politely decline the rest, keep the core circle pure
choices.visible_reward: Higher quality core team, loyalty guaranteed

text.content: Chen Ji examined each person who had declared their stance, his gaze like a blade. The intelligence from Yuling Valley, the goodwill from the Xuanwu Sect Elder, he noted them all. But those clearly just there to join the fun for benefits, he only politely cupped his hands: "Thank you for your kind intentions, Elder. I dare not impose." In this way, although the numbers were fewer, those who remained were meticulously selected partners.

choices.description: Use this opportunity to set a trap, treat the factions coming to pledge allegiance as chess pieces, pave the way for the ultimate goal
choices.visible_reward: Lay down crucial foreshadowing for the subsequent grand plan
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, may face betrayal from all sides

text.content: As everyone engaged in small talk, Chen Ji sank his consciousness into his Mental Sea and transmitted his voice to Mo Xiansheng: "Sir, the layout has begun." In the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's aged voice rang out: "Are you certain you wish to take this path? Once begun, there is no turning back." Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold arc: "From the day I chose this path, I never contemplated retreat." He silently calculated in his heart - three months? Sufficient. Enough to weave an inescapable net, trapping everyone within his chessboard.

Just as various factions were scrambling to declare their allegiance, an ancient jade slip in Chen Ji's sleeve suddenly grew slightly warm. His expression remained unchanged, yet his heart surged with immense waves of turmoil - this jade slip was the last memento Chen Nian had left him before her disappearance. Seventeen years had passed without the slightest response, yet why now...? He calmly slipped his hand into his sleeve, fingertips touching the warm jade surface, and several faint characters materialized upon it.

dialogue.content: "Everyone." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, interrupting the crowd's chatter, a composed smile on his face, "Today, I am deeply grateful for your kindness. However, the search for the Tianji Record should not be publicized. Please return first, and allow me to organize my thoughts. I will contact everyone in three days." He paused, his gaze sweeping over Su Qingyao, "During this time, please have Sister Su coordinate matters." Su Qingyao startled slightly, then nodded: "Rest assured." She noticed the fleeting heaviness in Chen Ji's eyes and knew he must have discovered something significant.

text.content: After the crowd dispersed, Chen Ji returned to his quarters alone. He waved his hand to set up several barriers, ensuring absolute security, before taking out the jade slip. Seventeen years of dust had left its surface covered with cracks, yet the characters remained clearly legible - they were Chen Nian's childish handwriting from childhood: "Brother, if you're reading this, it means I'm already gone. Don't look for me. The complete version of the Tianji Record is somewhere..." The subsequent characters were severed by a deep crack, as if deliberately erased.

Chen Ji's hand holding the jade slip trembled slightly. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Chen Nian... did she know back then? Did she know the whereabouts of the complete Tianji Record? She was only eight when she disappeared, how could she... A terrifying conjecture formed in his mind. Perhaps she didn't "disappear" but was deliberately taken. Because she knew something she shouldn't have known. "Nian'er..." he murmured softly, his eyes slightly reddening, then immediately replaced by an icy resolve, "Wait for me. This time, no one can stop me."

At this moment, Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted up from within his Mental Sea: "Chen Ji, this handwriting on the jade slip... the old man recognizes it." Chen Ji jerked his head up: "Who?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, seemingly choosing his words carefully: "The person who wrote these characters has intricate connections to the original owner of the Tianji Record. That child Chen Nian... she's far more extraordinary than you imagine." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Just as he was about to press further, Mo Xiansheng had already fallen silent, unresponsive no matter how he called out. Outside the window, the setting sun sank, stretching Chen Ji's shadow long. Three months, the countdown had begun. And the iceberg of truth was only beginning to reveal a corner.
